newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC April output rises to 27.02 mln bpd - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC April output rises to 27.02 mln bpd - MEES.

text.p: Higher Iranian production helped lift OPEC's crude oil output by over 400,000 barrels per day (bpd) in April to 27.02 million bpd from 26.60 million in March, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.

"The April rise...was in large part attributable to an increase of some 305,000 bpd in Iranian output, back to a more normal level of 3.755 million bpd after it had dipped to an exceptionally low figure of 3.45 million bpd in March, apparently as a result of loading problems," it said.
The newsletter said average Iranian crude output in the first four months of the year averaged 3.65 million bpd.
It said Iranian crude exports "regained a more regular rhythm" at an average 2.55 million bpd in April from 2.251 million bpd in March.
MEES estimated that Iraqi crude output rose to 1.32 million bpd in April, up 70,000 bpd over March.

"This increase is attributable to higher sales volumes under the U.N. oil-for-food programme to compensate for declining prices in order to attain the relevant value requirement for the second 90-day period."
A Reuters survey of OPEC officials, oil companies and analysts put OPEC April output at 27.05 million bpd from a revised 26.85 million in March.
